title: Forer Effect
coreMove: Name the Forer effect effect in the room, then redesign the next choice so it cannot choose for you.
sourcePressure: The frozen TOC and official source notes frame Forer Effect as a specific decision error around Forer effect, Barnum, personal validation. Traceable support includes The fallacy of personal validation: A classroom demonstration of gullibility.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Forer Effect as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: name the forer effect effect in the room, then redesign the next choice so it cannot choose for you.

hook: Do not open with a definition of Forer Effect.

counterintuition: Avoid the reusable shape where the obvious answer is wrong and the opposite is true.

examples: No coffee mug, classroom whiteboard, bus depot, radiator, bike helmet, or narrow kitchen shell.
